reading.summary: LDW280-17619-11, a flat tapered link: a plate 1 3/4 long and 5/8 wide with R 11/64 round ends
reading.description: One view (plan) of a flat part, LDW280-17619-11, on sheet 3 of LDW280-17619 (B form ENG 73.1 6-64, SCALE NONE). The outline is one closed chain: a straight top and bottom flat 17/32 long in the middle, the full 5/8 width, tapering straight down to round ends of R 11/64 (TYP: both ends) whose centres lie on the horizontal centre line; overall length 1 3/4 over the ends. Dimensions: 1 3/4 overall, 39/64 from the left end to the start of the top flat, 17/32 the flat, 5/8 the width, 5/16 from the bottom flat to the centre line (half the width: the part is symmetric about it). A horizontal centre line runs through both end centres, each end centre has a centre mark and a short vertical centre line; a faint dotted vertical axis marks the middle. A boxed X at the middle is the marking region the operations note refers to (RUBBER STAMP PART NUMBER AND ALL OTHER MARKINGS IN REGION MARKED [boxed X]). Note 1: NO TOOLING HOLES PERMITTED IN PARTS. Made by blanking or routing from sheet stock (thickness and material are not on this sheet: in the parts list). It is a small link, spacer or strap; nothing on this sheet says what it attaches to.
